description: IWebPushSender that encrypts and delivers Web Push payloads to browser push services using VAPID (via the WebPush library). A 404/410 from the push service is surfaced as an expired TmWebPushResult so the caller can prune the dead subscription. Ships in the optional Tempo.Blazor.WebPush package so hosts opt into the WebPush dependency.

members.name: SendAsync
members.description: Encrypts and sends a payload to a single push subscription; returns a result that flags an expired subscription (HTTP 404/410) so the caller can prune it.
